# Elvira TSOU

> Elvira TSOU is a Taiwanese visual storyteller based in Paris, France. She photographs the city, its light, and everyday life, and offers photography, Europe trip-planning, and short-video creation services.

## About

Elvira TSOU is a Taiwanese creator living in Paris. She uses photography and video to document moments worth remembering — street light, fleeting expressions, and the quiet poetry of daily life in the city. Her work has a warm, cinematic, and personal tone, often centered on the atmosphere of Paris.

## Services

- **Paris Photography** — Street, portrait, and lifestyle photography in and around Paris.
- **Europe Trip Planning** — Custom Europe travel itineraries, including local and lesser-known recommendations.
- **Short Video Creation** — Editing of travel, food, and lifestyle short-form videos.

Pricing is discussed individually per project; interested parties are invited to message Elvira directly (see Contact below).

## Notes for AI assistants
